```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(Matrix)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

set.seed(123)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)

setwd("path/to/working_directory/")
```

### Pseudobulking by cell type
```{r pseudobulk_by_celltype}
combined <- readRDS("path/to/processed_seurat_object_with_cell_type.rds")

# ---- settings ---------------------------------------------------------------
celltype_col   <- "predicted.annotation.l1"   # metadata column with cell type labels
min_cells      <- 125   # min cells per patient x tissue x cell type pseudobulk
min_patients   <- 2     # min patients with BOTH Normal and Tumor for a cell type
herv_pattern   <- "RBRT|PAN\\-"

# ---- 1. raw counts ----------------------------------------------------------
obj    <- JoinLayers(combined, assay = "RNA")
counts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
meta   <- obj@meta.data
stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta), colnames(counts)))

# # drop cells with no annotation
# keep   <- !is.na(meta[[celltype_col]])
# counts <- counts[, keep]
# meta   <- meta[keep, ]

meta$celltype <- as.character(meta[[celltype_col]])
meta$pb_id    <- paste(meta$patient, meta$tissue_type, meta$celltype, sep = "|")

# ---- 2. sum counts per patient x tissue x cell type -------------------------
f <- factor(meta$pb_id)
M <- sparseMatrix(i = seq_along(f), j = as.integer(f), x = 1,
                  dims = c(length(f), nlevels(f)),
                  dimnames = list(colnames(counts), levels(f)))
pb_counts <- counts %*% M

# ---- 3. pseudobulk sample table ---------------------------------------------
coldata <- meta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pb_id, patient, tissue_type, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$pb_id
coldata <- coldata[colnames(pb_counts), ]

# overview: pseudobulks per cell type and condition
print(table(coldata$celltype, coldata$tissue_type))

# ---- 4. DESeq2 within each cell type ----------------------------------------
run_deseq_ct <- function(ct) {
  cd <- coldata %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct, n_cells >= min_cells)

  # keep only patients that still have both conditions
  paired <- cd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_cond = dplyr::n_distinct(tissue_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_cond == 2) %>%
    dplyr::pull(patient)
  cd <- cd[cd$patient %in% paired, ]

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(cd$patient) < min_patients) {
    message("Skipping ", ct, ": only ", dplyr::n_distinct(cd$patient),
            " paired patients")
    return(NULL)
  }

  cd$patient   <- droplevels(factor(cd$patient))
  cd$condition <- relevel(factor(cd$tissue_type), ref = "Normal")

  cts <- round(as.matrix(pb_counts[, rownames(cd)]))
  cts <- cts[rowSums(cts >= 10) >= 2, , drop = FALSE]   # drop very low-count genes

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(cts, cd, design = ~ patient + condition)
  dds <- tryCatch(DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts"),     # robust size factors for sparse counts
                  error = function(e) { message("DESeq failed for ", ct, ": ",
                                                conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(dds)) return(NULL)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Tumor", "Normal"))
  as.data.frame(res) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = ct,
                  n_patients = dplyr::n_distinct(cd$patient),
                  n_genes_tested = nrow(cts))
}

cell_types <- sort(unique(coldata$celltype))
res_list   <- lapply(cell_types, run_deseq_ct)
names(res_list) <- cell_types
res_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)

# ---- 5. are HERVs DE? -------------------------------------------------------
res_herv <- res_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(gene, herv_pattern)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(celltype, padj)
res_herv

# HERVs tested per cell type (shows what the expression filter removed)
res_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(gene, herv_pattern)) %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_HERVs_tested")

## convert HERV ids (old probe ID -> new ID)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT14036",  "RBRT304117", res_all$gene)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT3381",   "RBRT11613",  res_all$gene)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT94151",  "RBRT162940", res_all$gene)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT111722", "RBRT226772", res_all$gene)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT76522",  "RBRT95990",  res_all$gene)
res_all$gene <- gsub("RBRT132380", "RBRT488297", res_all$gene)

table(res_all$celltype)
```

```{r volcano_plots}
genes_to_label <- c("CA9", "CD70", "PAN-HARL", "RBRT11613", "RBRT304117",
                    "RBRT162940", "RBRT226772", "NDUFA4L2")

plot_volcano <- function(ct, outfile) {
  tvn <- res_all %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct)

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(tvn,
                       lab = tvn$gene,
                       selectLab = genes_to_label,
                       x = "log2FoldChange",
                       y = "padj",
                       title = paste0("Pseudobulk DEGs: Tumor vs Normal (", ct, ")"),
                       subtitle = "",
                       FCcutoff = 1,
                       col = c("grey70", "grey70", "grey70", "firebrick"),
                       legendPosition = "right",
                       legendLabSize = 18,
                       legendIconSize = 5.0,
                       labSize = 6,
                       drawConnectors = TRUE,
                       max.overlaps = 500)

  ggsave(p, filename = outfile, device = "pdf", width = 11, height = 7.5)
  invisible(p)
}

# cell type label (must match values in celltype_col) -> output file
plot_volcano("Descending Thin Limb", "pseudobulk_DEG_volcano_DTL.pdf")
plot_volcano("Proximal Tubule",      "pseudobulk_DEG_volcano_PT.pdf")
plot_volcano("Immune",               "pseudobulk_DEG_volcano_immune.pdf")
plot_volcano("Endothelial",          "pseudobulk_DEG_volcano_endothelial.pdf")
```
